authored_surface.evaluation: construct one inert marker plus scheduler-owned sidecar during stage-N authored execution; select pre-resolved and precompiled authority, execute, and stitch only after the complete stage-N AST returns
authored_surface.availability: neutral executable authority only; Perl, Rust, Dart, Julia, PUC Lua, LuaJIT, recurring, and public authoring remain pending under FUTURE-PARITY-BACKLOG.14.7.3-.10

policy.authority: the caller freezes aliases, declaring-spec-relative candidates, ordered search-root candidates, ordered provider candidates, resolves every statically declared selector, and freezes immutable already-compiled registry entries before authored execution
policy.resolution: all alias, declaring-spec-relative, search-root, and provider discovery completes before authored execution; the post-AST resolve phase is a pure frozen-map selection in that priority order, with missing, same-priority ambiguity, and alias-relative collision as hard diagnostics
policy.loading: authored parser identity, text, provenance, marker, and sidecar grant no filesystem, path, URI, network, environment, import enumeration, provider query, compilation, or registry mutation authority
policy.provenance: direct text carries one same-source half-open Unicode-scalar span; derived text carries a nonempty ordered list of direct spans under concatenate_in_order and never claims one synthetic contiguous span
policy.job_id: parse_job:v2:sha256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON containing contract version, declaring spec identity, parent AST path, node kind, payload kind, parser identity, selected top rule, and typed provenance
policy.queue: validate and resolve the complete stage before executing any job; process breadth-first by stage depth, then typed parent AST path (field names by Unicode scalar value and nonnegative indices numerically), typed provenance order under the same component ordering, and job id; stitch each settled result in that order and collect newly stitched markers only for the next depth
policy.cache: cache identity includes normalized parser identity, content digest, import graph fingerprint, selected top rule, spec language version, helper/action contract version, staged contract version, and sorted effective backend capabilities
policy.state: each job receives a fresh parser runtime context and immutable stage-chain view; siblings share only the caller cancellation, absolute deadline, remaining work budget, total-call counter, and registry snapshot
policy.capabilities: effective capabilities and policy modes are intersections and every source-detail or numeric resource ceiling is the stricter minimum; no child may elevate caller authority
policy.cycles: an exact active-chain parser/top/payload-digest/provenance tuple is a cycle; repeated parser/top over the same provenance lineage must be strictly contained with smaller total scalar extent
policy.bounds: stage depth, total calls, shared steps, result nodes, diagnostic bytes, cancellation, and deadline are checked at dispatch entry and child safe points without reset or extension
policy.result: replace_marker, replace_field, sibling_field, and append_child stitch into a detached AST copy; non-marker policies materialize the original exact text where the marker stood
policy.failure: fail aborts the composed parse; keep_text materializes original text and records a scheduler-sidecar diagnostic; diagnostic_node applies the selected target policy with one detached portable diagnostic node
policy.detachment: results and diagnostics are finite acyclic node-bounded plain data with no parser, registry, source authority, frame, transaction, cancellation, callback, host, path, or live handle
policy.transactions: parse-job declaration and staged dispatch are forbidden in uncommitted recognition; staged execution never supplies cursor progress to the completed parent parse
policy.compatibility: the existing function-body v1 sidecar remains actionir-body.spec/action_block/replace_field/body_ast/fail with legacy copied-text spans; it is accepted by an explicit adapter and cannot be emitted by parse_job v2

compatibility_v1.source_provenance: legacy copied exact text plus numeric offset and line span
